text: Every new TextOS credential gets a lifetime of 30 days by default, and no more than 90 days. A credential has to have at least 60 minutes left when it is issued, and a missing end date falls back to the 30-day default instead of creating a key that never ends. These limits are enforced by the TextOS service itself, not only by its command-line tool.
